'''Chukha-Trok''' was a hunter in [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] mythology that was born of a Ewok and a forest spirit. "Chukha-Trok" was a popular name given to male Ewoks,<ref name="GCG" /> such as [[Chukha-Trok/Legends|the woodcutter]] of the [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] tribe.<ref name="Caravan">''[[Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure]]''</ref>
